info.title: prdb Public API
info.description:
Read and write access to the prdb catalogue: videos, actors, sites, scene pre-database
releases, file hashes and the per-user lists built on top of them.

Authenticate every request except the health probe with an API key in the `X-Api-Key`
header. API access is part of the paid subscription tiers; requests are rate limited per
account and `GET /rate-limit` reports the remaining budget.

Every authenticated endpoint can answer `403` when the account has no subscription tier that
includes API access, `429` when the hourly or monthly budget is spent, and `503` while rate
limiting itself is unavailable. The API serves no content it cannot meter, so treat `503`
as retryable rather than as a permission problem.

Endpoints named `/{resource}/changes` are delta feeds: they return the current state of
rows changed since a cursor, including soft-deleted rows as tombstones, rather than a full
history of every mutation.

### Perceptual hashes

Every endpoint that accepts a `pHash` expects a 64-bit perceptual hash as 16 hexadecimal
characters, in either case; values are stored and returned uppercase. There is one
procedure for computing it — the one Stash uses — and a value produced any other way is
not comparable with the rest of the column, which nothing in the value itself reveals.

Sample 25 frames across the middle 90% of the runtime, one per timestamp, with the seek
placed **before** the input:
`ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -ss <t> -i <file> -frames:v 1 -vf scale=160:-2 -c:v bmp -f rawvideo -`.
Assemble them left to right and top to bottom into a 5x5 montage, scale that to 64x64 with
`github.com/nfnt/resize`'s bilinear filter — whose support scales with the downscale
factor, so it is not four-neighbour interpolation and no other library substitutes for it
— convert to luminance with 0.299/0.587/0.114, apply an unscaled DCT-II, and keep the
top-left 8x8 block row-major. Set the bit for every coefficient strictly above
`goimagehash`'s `MedianOfPixels` threshold, most significant bit first, keeping the DC
coefficient. `0000000000000000` is a valid hash, not an error code.

`pHash` values are matched for **equality**. Hamming-distance matching is not implemented.

The summary above is not enough to implement from, and it is not meant to be. The
normative specification — the exact resampler arithmetic, the threshold's quickselect
(which is not a median), the DCT divisor tables, and test vectors at three levels — is
published at <https://github.com/prdb-net/prdb-sdk/blob/main/docs/video-hashing.md>, with
the vectors as data at
<https://github.com/prdb-net/prdb-sdk/blob/main/docs/video-hashing-vectors.json>.

For .NET there is an implementation of it, the `Prdb.Hashing` package, which also computes
the `osHash`.

post.description: Marks up to 50 wanted videos of the currently authenticated user as fulfilled or unfulfilled in a single request. Returns one result per video, naming the outcome — updated, unchanged, not on the wanted list, or unknown video — so unknown and unwanted IDs do not fail the request; the status code stays 200. A 400 is only returned for form errors: an empty list, more than 50 entries, a video listed twice, or an invalid enum value. Setting isFulfilled to false clears the fulfilment timestamp, quality, external ID and application. Setting it to true without a fulfilledAtUtc stamps the server time, unless the entry is already fulfilled, in which case its timestamp is kept. Soft-deleted wanted entries are reported as not wanted and are not revived; use POST /wanted-videos/batch for that. The whole request counts as one request against the rate limit. Requires API key authentication.

post.description: Identifies up to 200 local files in one request and returns one result per file, mapped back by the client-assigned ref and in input order. Each file walks an identification ladder and the first rung that matches wins: OS hash, then perceptual hash (compared for equality), then a stored file name, then the file name without its extension as a scene release title, and finally the site read out of the file name. A pHash must be computed exactly as described under Perceptual hashes in the API description; a value from any other procedure skips that rung silently rather than failing, so send none if in doubt. matchedBy names the rung and confidence says how far the result can be trusted, so a client can decide which files it may file automatically and which it must show to a person. When a rung matches several videos equally well, the server does not guess: videoId is null, confidence is ambiguous and every candidate is listed. A file that matches nothing is a result with confidence none, not an error. Set includeVideoDetails to receive the full video document per matched file; it is off by default because 200 full documents is a large response. The whole request counts as one request against the rate limit. Nothing sent to this endpoint is stored. Requires API key authentication.

post.description: Submits up to 200 assignments of a file hash to a video, on behalf of the authenticated user. Intended for assignments a person confirmed in a client's UI — exactly the cases automatic detection missed. Each entry needs a videoId and an osHash; the osHash is the only aggregation key, so an entry carrying only a pHash cannot be used. A pHash must be computed exactly as described under Perceptual hashes in the API description; a value from any other procedure is stored but can never be matched. The filename is optional and may be withheld; the endpoint works without it. Every entry gets its own outcome and the status stays 200: an unknown videoId is reported as videoNotFound, and an assignment that contradicts an existing one is stored as conflicted rather than overwriting it. Submissions are recorded in their own table. They appear in no read endpoint and change no lookup result; whether they ever enter the aggregated hash set is decided by the scraper's aggregation job, not here. Clients must make this strictly opt-in and off by default — that is a client-side obligation the API cannot enforce. Requires API key authentication.

get.description: Returns a paged list of sites ordered by title ascending. Supports filtering by search term matched against site title. The full list fits in a single request at pageSize=1000. Every response carries a weak ETag covering the matched rows and the paging, sorting and search parameters; send it back as If-None-Match to get 304 Not Modified while nothing changed. Because the shared read-only output cache does not vary by If-None-Match, a request that hits the cache is answered with 200 and a body instead of 304 — that is expected, not an error. Sites carry no alias names, and matching a file name to a site happens exclusively server-side in POST /videos/identify. Requires API key authentication.

id.description: Unique identifier of the PreDb entry.

title.description: Release title as indexed in PreDb.

releaseDate.description: Release date associated with the entry.

category.description: Readable category value: Movies, TvShows, or Adult.

filesize.description: Optional file size value if known.

PreDbSummaryDto.description: Summary representation of a PreDb entry.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within this window.

used.description: Number of requests made within the current window.

remaining.description: Number of requests remaining before the limit is reached.

resetsInSeconds.description: Seconds until the oldest request in the window expires, reducing the used count by one.

RateLimitWindowStatus.description: Rate limit status for a single time window.

reason.description: Allowed values: NotRelatedToVideo, SpamOrPromotional, OffensiveOrProhibited, DuplicateOrLowQuality, MisleadingOrWrongPreview, CopyrightConcern, Other.

totalGroups.description: Number of distinct videos in the result set (capped at 500).

networkId.description: Unique identifier of the network this site belongs to, if any.

networkTitle.description: Title of the network this site belongs to, if any.

updatedAtUtc.description: When this site was last changed.

SubmitFilehashOutcome.description: Outcome of a single submission. Known values: Recorded (0), Updated (1), Conflicted (2), VideoNotFound (3).

items.description: Assignments to submit. Between 1 and 200 entries.

SubmitVideoFilehashesRequest.description: Request body for submitting confirmed hash-to-video assignments.

results.description: One result per submitted entry, in request order.

SubmitVideoFilehashesResponse.description: Per-entry outcome of a filehash submission.

videoId.description: The video this file is. Required — a hash observation without an assignment is not accepted.

osHash.description: OS hash of the file, 16 hexadecimal characters. Required; it is the only aggregation key.

pHash.description:
Perceptual hash of the file, 16 hexadecimal characters, if the client computed one. It must
be computed as "Perceptual hashes" in the API description prescribes; a submission carrying
a value from another procedure contributes a row nothing can match.

filesize.description: Size of the file in bytes.

filename.description: File name without directory. Optional — a client may withhold it, and the endpoint works without it.

osHash.description: The OS hash of the entry, normalized to upper case.

SubmitVideoFilehashResultDto.description: What happened to one submitted assignment.

totalCount.description: Total number of active unlinked filehash entries matching the current filters.

sortBy.description: Resolved sort field for the current query.

sortDirection.description: Resolved sort direction for the current query.

UnlinkedVideoFilehashesResponse.description: Paged list of active filehash entries that are not linked to a video.

filename.description: The filename as reported by the indexer/download source.

osHash.description: Optional OS hash value as a 16-character fixed-length string.

pHash.description:
Optional perceptual hash value, 16 hexadecimal characters. It must be computed as
"Perceptual hashes" in the API description prescribes; a value from another procedure
is stored but can never be matched.

indexerId.description: Indexer-specific identifier for the download item.

downloadIdentifier.description: Download identifier returned by the indexer or download client.

isFulfilled.description: Whether the wanted video has been fulfilled.

fulfilledAtUtc.description: When the wanted video was fulfilled, if applicable.

fulfillmentExternalId.description: External identifier from the fulfilling application, if applicable.

fulfillmentByApp.description: Known values: Sabnzbd (0), Nzbget (1), Filesystem (2), Other (3), Ordeno (4).

isFulfilled.description: Whether this wanted video has been fulfilled.

fulfilledAtUtc.description: When the wanted video was fulfilled, if applicable.

fulfillmentExternalId.description: External identifier from the fulfilling application, if applicable.

fulfillmentByApp.description: Known values: Sabnzbd (0), Nzbget (1), Filesystem (2), Other (3), Ordeno (4).

createdAtUtc.description: When this wanted video entry was created.

updatedAtUtc.description: When this wanted video entry was last updated.

userHash.description:
Stable HMAC-SHA256 hex digest derived from the user's immutable ID.
Suitable as a durable public identifier — does not change unless the server secret rotates.

activeSubscriptions.description: All subscriptions with Status=Active and an end date in the future.

UserIdentityResponse.description: Identity and subscription state for the authenticated user.

images.description:
Images for this actor, ordered by ActorImageType VideoDetailActorImageDto.ImageType ascending
(Thumbnail, Poster, Face), then oldest first, with the image ID as the tie-breaker. The order
is stable across requests.

cdnPath.description:
Absolute CDN URL for the image, if available. Despite the field name this is a complete URL
including scheme and host — it needs no base to be prepended and is ready to request as-is.
The same image is exposed as `url` by the actor endpoints.

images.description:
Images for this video, ordered oldest first by the time they were added, with the image ID
as the tie-breaker. The order is stable across requests.

cdnPath.description:
Absolute CDN URL for the image, if available. Despite the field name this is a complete URL
including scheme and host — it needs no base to be prepended and is ready to request as-is.

filename.description: Original filename submitted for this filehash record.

osHash.description: OS hash value as stored, or null when not available.

pHash.description: P hash value as stored, or null when not available.

submissionCount.description: Number of submissions merged into this filehash record.

isVerified.description: Whether this filehash record has been verified.

deletedAtUtc.description: Timestamp when the row was soft-deleted, or null when still active.

siteId.description: Unique identifier of the site this video belongs to.

siteTitle.description: Title of the site this video belongs to.

releaseDate.description: Release date of the video, if known.

createdAtUtc.description: Timestamp when the video was created in PRDB.

basedOnFileWithOsHash.description: Server-validated 16-character OS hash of the file the preview is based on.

url.description: Resolved public CDN URL for the stored image object.

vttUrl.description: Resolved public CDN URL for the paired WebVTT metadata object when this image is a sprite sheet.

spriteTileCount.description: Number of sprite tiles described by the paired WebVTT metadata object.

spriteTileWidth.description: Uniform sprite tile width in pixels.

spriteTileHeight.description: Uniform sprite tile height in pixels.

spriteColumns.description: Number of occupied tile columns in the sprite-sheet grid.

spriteRows.description: Number of occupied tile rows in the sprite-sheet grid.

fulfillmentByApp.description: Known values: Sabnzbd (0), Nzbget (1), Filesystem (2), Other (3), Ordeno (4).

siteTitle.description: Title of the site this video belongs to.

videoReleaseDate.description: Release date of the video, if known.

videoCreatedAtUtc.description: When the video was added to the database.

imageCdnPath.description: Absolute CDN URL for the video's primary image, if available.

isFulfilled.description: Whether this wanted video has been fulfilled.

fulfilledAtUtc.description: When the wanted video was fulfilled, if applicable.

fulfillmentExternalId.description: External identifier from the fulfilling application, if applicable.

ApiKey.description: API key issued per user. Send it in the `X-Api-Key` request header. Every endpoint except the health probe requires it; a missing or unknown key returns 401.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key

tags.name: Videos
tags.description: Video metadata: paged listing with filters, plus single and batch lookup by ID.

tags.name: VideoFilehashes
tags.description: File hashes aggregated per video: lookup by hash, per-video reads, a latest feed and a delta feed.

tags.name: VideoFilehashSubmissions
tags.description: Hash-to-video assignments submitted by the calling user. Write-only: submissions live apart from the aggregated hash set and change no read result.

tags.name: VideoUserImages
tags.description: User-submitted images for videos: submission, listing by video or source file hash, moderation reports and a delta feed.

tags.name: Actors
tags.description: Actor metadata: paged listing, single and batch lookup by ID, and a delta feed.

tags.name: FavoriteActors
tags.description: The favorite actors of the user behind the calling API key.

tags.name: FavoriteSites
tags.description: The favorite sites of the user behind the calling API key.

tags.name: WantedVideos
tags.description: The wanted-video list of the user behind the calling API key, including batch add.

tags.name: PreDb
tags.description: Scene pre-database releases: paged listing, a latest feed and search by video.

tags.name: IndexerFilehashes
tags.description: File hashes observed in indexer releases: lookup by hash, a latest feed and a delta feed.

tags.name: DownloadedFromIndexers
tags.description: Indexer downloads reported by the calling user, and the filenames belonging to each download.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Service health probe. The only endpoint that needs no API key.

tags.name: RateLimit
tags.description: The remaining rate-limit budget of the calling API key.

tags.name: UserIdentity
tags.description: The identity of the user behind the calling API key.
